$comment: Occurrence-bound prediction receipts for closure stimuli. A receipt names the ONE holder occurrence its cause explains; the checker measures that every differing path lies under it. Freeze order is load-bearing: `digest` covers the authored fields and is computed before the engine is asked, so a prediction edited toward an engine result fails clause 0 rather than passing silently.

source.authority: CASE_FLATTENING_DISCARDS_NEST_MEMBERSHIP / REL_DERIVATION_DISCARDS_MEMBERSHIP: the projection at this occurrence drops the nest level that carried membership

target.authority: CASE_NESTED_SUBTOTALS_OFF_GRAIN / REL_GRAIN_SUBTOTAL_MISMATCH: a nest over levels [country, state] declares exactly its prefixes as grains, so a subtotal to [sale_id] is not one of them
